title: tier-2 shipped code: the collision sweep's bounds stage against 0x142cd5540
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-sim/src/collide.rs (sweep_bounds), called by crates/ow-sim/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the collision_sweep_bounds entry.
The oracle runs the real 0x142cd5540 and the harness compares all three 0x10-byte output quads byte for byte, plus the query block pointee.
The block and its local support-point array share one pointee so the block's +0x30 pointer is the arena address the oracle dereferences.
The image's .pdata entry for 0x142cd5540 is truncated at 0x42 bytes, so the unit declares the exact extent (0x1a0) as coverageWindow.
acknowledgedGaps: This unit verifies the sweep's start/end/expansion stage only. The query driver 0x142cbd510 (the SAT rejection and the narrowphase dispatch), the shape world transform 0x142cb8b80 and the five per-type narrowphases remain open.
